title: osmanthus ilicifolius f. myrtifolius
intro: Osmanthus ilicifolius f. myrtifolius, commonly known as Sweet Osmanthus, is a plant species within the family Oleaceae. Sweet Osmanthus is a flowering plant known for its fragrant flowers, which are often used in traditional medicine and as a natural fragrance. The plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Osmanthus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
